sessions_reload.harnessRouteLimitation: Manual fixture uses a memory router, so POS was reopened after reload; no workspace storage was edited by QA

resolved_defects.problem: Catalog scroll flex child had no bounded ancestor and could grow with loaded pages.
resolved_defects.fix: CatalogPanel height clamp(620px, calc(100dvh - 220px), 1040px), accessible local overflow.
resolved_defects.proof: Panel remains 672px at viewport 892px after one 24-to-48 append; no eager third page; anchor drift 1px.

resolved_defects.problem: Absolutely positioned visually-hidden stepper descriptions escaped the clipping ancestor and created a large blank document tail.
resolved_defects.fix: Position the stepper wrapper relative; focused regression checks the containing block.
resolved_defects.after: Final widths 320/600: HTML/body heights equal; CTA visible and center hit-test unobscured.

resolved_defects.problem: MUI sx height:1 resolved to100%, leaving an oversized blank infinite-scroll sentinel.
resolved_defects.fix: Explicit height:"1px"; focused regression observes computed sentinel height.
resolved_defects.after: Final eight-profile metrics and screenshots use a 1px sentinel.

limits: This proves Client behavior against an explicit synthetic transport, not Server transaction durability, real payments, hardware scanner input or real product-image upload.
Native reload restored both stored carts and the active sale after reopening POS: the manual fixture uses an in-memory router, so route persistence itself is outside this proof.
At 320x700, the bounded panel has 10px of accessible outer scrolling due to wrapped scanner help; controls remain reachable.
Very large totals wrap within the available width without truncation; mobile actions require ordinary document scrolling.
Catalogue DOM remains the loaded infinite-query pages; arbitrary-scale virtualization and performance are outside this change.
Browser operator selector/transition corrections preceded the final recorded proofs; no synthetic checkout was replayed after an uncertain result.

Physical scanner, physical phone, real payment collection and provider inference were not exercised.
